inlineContent.text: The numbers the upstream protocol used for features Headwire does not take (2–7, 15–18, 21, 24,
25, 27, 32) stay unused so a capture of either protocol never reads as the other. The numbers
Headwire retired stay unused too, and are never given to a new kind: 9 (viewport), 12 (client
stats), 14 (cursor shape), 26 (host pointer) and 44 (source selection). No build ever sent
them, but helpers up to v0.8 still act on 9 and 44. A kind this build does not know parses as
and is skipped, so an older peer keeps working against a newer one.
